title: Salmonella Braenderup outbreak case-control study, Germany 2021
derivation: None. Files as published; md5 checksums match the Zenodo record's.

paper.citation: Łuczyńska A, et al. Epidemiol Infect. 2023;151:e70.
paper.read: Full text read on PMC, 2026-11-03. The supplement was not read.

verification.againstPaperTable3: April control counts for any melon, Galia, cantaloupe, honeydew and watermelon match, classical and matched panel
verification.crudeOddsRatios: Computed by an independent script from the files and by the app; they agree

limits: Crude odds ratios; the paper's are adjusted for age and sex.
Every classical control has the id NA.
The matched file codes panel controls fall 0, which is the classical controls' code in the complete file.
bioladen and markt were filled in for cases only, and neither is in the codebook.
bio joins two questions: for cases it repeats bioladen (organic shop), for controls it is read from biolm (organic food).
bula and kreis are not in the codebook; bula is read as the official state code.

boundaries.what: Germany's 16 federal states, for the map of where the cases lived
boundaries.source: Federal Agency for Cartography and Geodesy (BKG), as geoBoundaries publishes it (gbOpen, DEU, ADM1, boundaryID DEU-ADM1-10402087), year represented 2021
boundaries.use: As published, 16 features named by shapeISO; also kept in fieldwork-project.json.gz.

authored.what: The 16 federal states: the two-digit official state code as bula writes it (no leading zero), the ISO 3166-2 code geoBoundaries names each feature by, and the name.
authored.why: bula is not in the codebook. It is read as the official state code because kreis begins with it in all 110 classical controls; the cases have no kreis.
